what: Four lightning shards fan out from the pressed spot starting at −172.5° (±8°) with 35° spacing — each shard unfolds with a bounce (.34,1.56,.64,1) over .16s from 8~11px away and travels 5~8px, then folds away from the tail over .18s power2.out. Each shard is delayed 0~.03s and tilted ±6°, so it feels hand-drawn, with up to 14 clusters at once

options.size: Piece scale, default 1 (as in the original — piece length about 13~23px)
options.max: Number of chunks left at once, default 14
options.touch: When on, a touch press also makes it bounce (default is mouse only — the original handles touch separately as a click)

note: One piece panel is attached to body with position:fixed (it doesn’t block clicks). It doesn’t pop up over input fields or text-editing fields

from.where: shared.js press lightning (.t-shards — original click-shards: four · from −172.5±8° in 35°·±6° steps · spacing 8~11 · travel out 5~8 · size .7~.9 · .16s quick → .18s power2.out · 14 chunks)
